# Project Overview

## Project Information

::: card
### PhD Orthodontics

This project focuses on improving digital marketing performance for an orthodontic practice.

Key areas include:

-   Website User Experience
-   Search Engine Optimization (SEO)
-   Google Ads Performance
-   Consumer Insights
-   Lead Generation
:::

# Research Objectives

## Consumer Insights

::: card
### Research Focus

Understand how website content and digital marketing influence prospective patients' trust, credibility, and intention to request a consultation.

### Research Methods

-   Online Surveys
-   Consumer Behavior Analysis
-   Descriptive Statistics
-   Regression Analysis
:::

# Project Progress

## Current Stage

::: card
### Research and Planning

The project is currently focused on research design, survey development, and digital marketing analysis.
:::
